_comment: EXAMPLE FILE. Copy to competitors.json and replace with your own owner + competitor details. The fictional values below (Northwind Analytics vs. Beacon and Cirrus) show the shape. The 'notes' fields give agents starting context — keep them updated as you learn more.

owner.name: Northwind Analytics
owner.description: Warehouse-native product analytics for B2B SaaS, fintech, and developer-tools teams. 1,500+ customers in 40+ countries. Differentiators: runs on the customer's own warehouse, self-serve setup, usage-based pricing.

competitors.name: Beacon
competitors.notes: Incumbent product-analytics platform. Strong in enterprise: SSO, governance, and a large integration marketplace. Aggressive mid-market land-and-expand. Typical review complaints: pricing opacity and a steep setup process.

competitors.name: Cirrus
competitors.notes: Fast-moving challenger. Recently shipped an AI natural-language query assistant and bundled session replay into the core plan. Heavy content and community investment. Typical review complaints: reliability at scale and support response times.
